settings.title: Settings
settings.siteInfoDescription: Basic information about your Monoize instance
settings.apiBaseUrlDescription: The API base URL for downstream clients to connect to this proxy, displayed on the dashboard
settings.modelsDevBaseUrlDescription: Complete URL used to synchronize model metadata and prices from Models.dev
settings.allowRegistrationDescription: Allow new users to register accounts

settings.sessionSecurityDescription: Configure session and API key limits

settings.maxApiKeysDescription: Maximum number of API keys each user can create
settings.reasoningSuffixMapDescription: Map model name suffixes to reasoning effort levels. When a requested model has no exact match, suffixes are stripped to find the base model and the mapped effort level is injected.
settings.globalTransformsDescription: Configure system-wide transform rules applied after provider transforms and before API-key transforms.
settings.globalTransformsHelp: Rules are ordered within each phase. Request and response phases both use provider → global → API key priority.
settings.globalModelRedirectsDescription: Rewrite downstream model names before allowlists, routing, billing, and transforms. API-key rules take priority.
settings.globalModelRedirectsEmpty: No global redirects. Model names pass through unchanged unless an API key has its own rule.
settings.globalModelRedirectsHelp: Full-match Rust regular expressions. First match wins; maximum 32 rules.
settings.affinityRoutingDescription: Control whether requests from the same Agent thread stay on the selected channel after routing or fallback. Channel settings can override each global value.
settings.affinityEnabledDescription: Keep an active Agent thread on its selected provider and channel until the binding expires or becomes ineligible.
settings.affinityIdleTtlSecondsDescription: Remove a binding after this many seconds without a successful request. Each success refreshes the idle timer.
settings.affinityFailbackModeDescription: Keep the current fallback channel, or retry normal provider priority after the failback delay.
settings.affinityFailbackDelaySecondsDescription: Under Prefer Higher Priority, wait this long from binding creation before an earlier eligible provider can replace the current target.
settings.healthMonitoringDescription: Configure active channel liveness probes for Monoize waterfall routing.
settings.activeProbeEnabledDescription: When enabled, unhealthy channels are periodically probed for recovery.
settings.enableEstimatedBillingDescription: When enabled, Monoize may charge from estimated usage when upstream usage is missing.
settings.requestCaptureEnabledDescription: Master switch for per-API-key request capture dumps. When off, no dump files are written.
settings.requestCaptureRetentionDaysDescription: Automatically delete capture dump files older than this number of days.
settings.maskSensitiveInfoDescription: Mask upstream URLs, domains, IPs, and API keys in client-facing error messages and non-admin request-log reads. When off, raw upstream error text is exposed.
settings.stripCrossProtocolNestedExtraDescription: Remove nested downstream-only passthrough state before cross-family upstream encoding.
settings.activeProbeSuccessThresholdDescription: Consecutive successful probes required to mark a channel healthy.
settings.activeProbeModelPlaceholder: Leave empty to use provider first model
settings.activeProbeModelDescription: When set, this model is used for completion probes on all providers.
settings.passiveFailureThresholdDescription: N failures within the sampling window triggers circuit break.
settings.passiveCooldownSecondsDescription: Cooldown duration after passive breaker opens for transient failures.
settings.passiveWindowSecondsDescription: Sliding time window used for passive failure-count calculation.
settings.passiveMinSamplesDescription: Minimum sample count retained for passive breaker compatibility.
settings.passiveFailureRateThresholdDescription: Failure-rate threshold retained for passive breaker compatibility.
settings.passiveRateLimitCooldownSecondsDescripti: Short cooldown used when breaker opens due to rate-limit pressure (HTTP 429).
settings.requestTimeoutMsDescription: Global default timeout for upstream requests in milliseconds. Providers can override this value.
settings.effortValues: Valid: none, minimum, low, medium, high, xhigh, max
